one: Build an AI product and agent from 0 to 1: AI fit, latency/quality/cost, evaluation, and Demo Day.
pos: MS&E 203 is a project-based course where students build a real AI product in one quarter. It requires justifying why AI is needed, handling latency/quality/cost trade-offs, rigorously evaluating the system, and presenting at Demo Day. Before enrolling, students complete self-study modules on git, AI coding tools, eval frameworks, and APIs.
topics: **Team build**: from individual mechanisms to a team product
prereq: Upper-level undergraduates/master's students; programming ability; capacity about 48 students (12 teams × 4).
assess: Mainly a project plus Demo Day; individual/team assignments may be included. Check the current syllabus for details.
who: People who want to start a company or build AI products; MS&E, CS, SymSys, EE backgrounds; anyone who needs a portfolio.
tips: Build a complementary team (engineering + design + business). Don't pick too large a problem; evaluation matters more than the demo.
